scripts.dev: npm run sync:brand && tsx watch server/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run sync:brand && vite build && tsup server/index.ts --format esm --target node22 --out-dir dist/server --clean
scripts.test:rls: npm run db:migrate:test && npm run check:function-allowlist && vitest run --config vitest.rls.config.ts
